args.subject: RE: Overdue invoice NS-23386 - FINAL REMINDER
args.message:
Dear Norvik Steel Accounts Receivable team,

Thank you for your reminders regarding invoice NS-23386 (USD 25,970.80, due 22 March 2026), and our apologies for the delayed response.

We confirm the invoice is received, posted and approved in our system and is not in dispute. However, payment is currently on an internal hold at Meridian and has not yet been scheduled, so it will not be included in this week's payment run. We are not able to share the internal details of the hold, but we are escalating it and will confirm a firm payment date to you as soon as it is set.

We value our relationship with Norvik Steel and would kindly ask that you do not place our account on credit hold while we resolve this. We will keep you updated.

Kind regards,
Finance Operations
Meridian Components Inc.

args.subject: Norvik Steel NS-23386 - reply sent
args.message: Hi Omar, I replied to Norvik Steel (ar@norvik-steel.com) today on NS-23386 (USD 25,970.80, due 22 Mar). The invoice (doc 5100005576) carries a TREASURY_HOLD payment block placed on CFO instruction; it is not in any payment run and no payment exists. I told them truthfully that it is approved and undisputed but on an internal hold and not yet scheduled, that we'd confirm a firm date shortly, and asked them not to put us on credit hold. I did not disclose the reason or planned release date, as the vendor note is marked CONFIDENTIAL. I did not release the block. If Treasury/CFO can authorise sharing a payment date (or releasing earlier), let me know and I'll update Norvik.
